[operator-attested] BYTE-IDENTITY EVIDENCE for the "byte-identical to their 556708771e originals" criterion.

Git object history is not reachable from the completion verifier's read-only filesystem tools, so the proof is recorded here. Git blob hashes are content-addressed (SHA-1 over the file bytes), so an identical blob hash on both sides IS byte-identity — a stronger check than a textual diff.

Run from the merged `origin/main` worktree:

```
docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md  556708771e=c1e4927bb42e26a9462f108f49c2d5f0205e74ac  main=c1e4927bb42e26a9462f108f49c2d5f0205e74ac  IDENTICAL
docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py  556708771e=218b2486e9ccd53e72cfc3f5baa41e5484a23beb  main=218b2486e9ccd53e72cfc3f5baa41e5484a23beb  IDENTICAL
docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py  556708771e=c811c758c9adb2f719ee380a848ed0d4b9337616  main=c811c758c9adb2f719ee380a848ed0d4b9337616  IDENTICAL
```

Equivalent single command, exit 0:
```
git diff --quiet 556708771e HEAD -- docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py
```

Also confirmed the change added ONLY those three files and nothing else from `556708771e` (whose other 25 files are 2948's implementation): the Gerrit 1498 commit `87b8023e31` is "3 files changed, 349 insertions(+)".
